reason: The primary text studies post-training quantization of Ideogram 4.0, a text-to-image flow-matching diffusion transformer, for image-generation quality, fidelity, memory, and latency on RTX 3090 GPUs. This is diffusion image-generation model compression rather than LLM inference, serving, or inference-time compression, so it falls outside this survey's scope despite being linked from an LLM INT8 paper.
title: Holding the FP8 Quality Ceiling at 8-Bit Weights and Activations: INT8 and GGUF Post-Training Quantization of Ideogram 4.0 for Consumer GPUs
